reef-race-intro: Spin, then hop your turtle to the island!
reef-race-help: Spin, then tap each next stone to move your turtle. Count as you go. At a shell, choose the bigger number.
reef-race-step: Tap the stone next to your turtle.
reef-race-try: Oops! Hop to the very next stone.
reef-race-try-back: Oops! Hop back to the stone behind you.
reef-race-forward: A wave! It pushes you two more stones.
reef-race-back: A crab! Hop back one stone.
reef-race-bonus-try: Look again. Which number is bigger?
reef-race-friend-win: Island friend got there first. Good racing!
reef-race-team-win: Our turtle reached the island! Hooray, team!
reef-race-tide-finish: The tide got there first. Good try, team!
reef-race-finish: A turtle reached the island! What a race!
